Voter Information for the 2026 State General Election 
The  State General Election  will be held on  Tuesday, November 3, 2026 .  Voters who wish to participate are encouraged to review the information below. 
New, in-person, voter registration is closed between Wednesday, October 28 - Tuesday, November 3 in the Town Clerk Office; HOWEVER, new voters can register at the polls the day of the 11/3/2026 election.  Contact the Clerk's Office if you or someone you know requires an Absentee Voter Registration.  
Visit the  ELECTIONS  homepage to learn more about registering to vote in NH.

The General Election is held at the Community Center, 4 Main St.,  Atkinson. Supervisors of the Checklist sessions are held at the Atkinson Town Hall, 19 Academy Ave. 
Important 2026 Change — Identification at the Polls 
Beginning June 2, 2026, New Hampshire no longer accepts school-issued or student ID cards to prove a voter’s identity at the polls (HB 323, 2026). To receive a ballot at the September 8 primary, every voter must present a government-issued photo ID. 
Absentee Ballots 
Absentee ballots are available now  at the Clerk's office until 5pm the night before any election  for either or both elections to voters who meet the legal criteria and provide the proper documentation. As of September 30, 2025, anyone requesting an absentee ballot must also provide photo-ID verification (RSA 657:17-c). For details, visit  Absentee Ballot Information , or contact the Town Clerk’s office.    
Town Clerk's Office will close at 5pm (not 6:30pm) on Tues., 11/3/26.
